findings.title: Cached account lookup bypasses cookie binding
findings.message: The cache-hit branch returns an account without proving that the request cookie belongs to it.
evidence: bluejay_auth/account_cache.go:73 returns the cached account before cookie validation

evidence.detail: A caller can present a stale account identifier with a different cookie.

findings.title: ForwardRequest dispatch omits tenant ownership check
findings.message: RouterRPC dispatches a ForwardRequest using in.Uuid without checking that the actor owns that UUID.

evidence.claim: No ownership predicate appears before dispatch.
